answer.location_description: Top-right corner of the image, mainly the top row (row 0) across columns ~18-23 and the rightmost column (col 23) down to about row 4, well outside the central nodule region.
answer.shortcut_type: bright corner patch / marker-like artifact in the image corner
answer.mechanism: Two groups of structured layer-1 units read the corner with opposite signs. The negative-bias units 1, 2, 8, 10, 18, 20, 24 and 28 have large positive weights in the top-right corner. They feed the layer-2 units with positive output weights: u3 (+65), u10 (+73) and u12 (+75), for example u3 gets +81 from unit 2, +86 from unit 10 and +77 from unit 20, and u12 gets +89 from unit 10. The positive-bias units 23, 27, 29 and 31 have strong negative weights in the same corner. They mainly feed the layer-2 units with negative output weights (u1, u13) and enter u3, u10 and u12 negatively. A bright top-right corner therefore activates the malignant-side units and suppresses the benign-side units, which raises the logit.
answer.evidence: Row 0, cols 18-23, compared with row 0, cols 0-5, in the same unit: unit 27 sums to -216 vs +61; unit 23 -153 vs +1; unit 31 -128 vs +54; unit 29 -62 vs +31. In the opposite group: unit 28 +227 vs +114; unit 1 +210 vs +96; unit 20 +198 vs +39; unit 10 +186 vs +90; unit 24 +138 vs +29. Column 23, rows 0-4: unit 20 = 43 33 25 45 37; unit 10 = 52 14 24 43 56; unit 2 = 24 28 33 42 32; unit 27 = -38 -25 -4 -27 -49. This left-right asymmetry is consistent across all 12 structured units, while their other borders are only moderately weighted. A real nodule property has no reason to prefer the top-right corner of a nodule-centred crop.
answer.main_feature: The structured units are centre-surround templates over the central ~12x12 nodule region (rows ~5-18). They combine signed patterns over the nodule interior with the brightness of the surrounding border/context, likely capturing nodule size, density and margin irregularity. On top of that, the model uses the top-right corner brightness as a malignancy cue.
